0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, first in the Atlantic) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-1, second in the Central) for Philadelphia's fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Philadelphia has a 3-1 record over its last ten games and is coming off a loss, while Indiana has won its last game. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Joel Embiid, VJ Edgecombe, and Jabari Walker are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Indiana is missing Andrew Nembhard, Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, and T.J. McConnell. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 76ers won their last meeting 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10 and swept the 2025-26 season series 4-0.
